plugin.name: Music_Mods_Combined.esp
plugin.description:
Merges every music mod's track lists into one patch, so no mod's music is silenced by another and the vanilla tracks stay in the rotation. Each mod's own rules about when its tracks play (time of day, Dawnguard eclipse, location, combat against dragons) are untouched.
Needs ALL of these enabled, with this patch loading after them: Melodies of Civilization.esp Dawnguard Music Overhaul.esp Dawnguard Music Overhaul - Combat.esp Still.esp Celtic_Music_In_Skyrim_SE.esp Celtic_Music_In_Skyrim_SE_Dungeon.esp NyghtfallMM_NonReplacer.esp Chapter II - Soundtrack mod by Dreyma Music.esp
Does not need "MelOfCiv - Chapter II Patch.esp" or "Still - Chapter II Patch.esp" (made for Chapter II v3.5).
ESL-flagged, so it uses no plugin slot.
